title: Research prices only
detail: Poisson independence and season-average rates are uncalibrated. All confidence labels capped Low. Regulation markets must not be mistaken for match winner including overtime.

title: Odds window is not confidence evidence
detail: At -250 the break-even probability is 71.43%; at +10000 it is 0.99%. A 70% probability by itself does not establish value, calibration or a reliable High pick.
